notes.title: Wordeous Full Release!
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39021137/7b0f633a65b0602f89253ca5eba0e23a19fc55c7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39021137/1c3527c3365370f5f296553d0c5e3e06b97d84b5.png[/img][/url]

During the early access period we got many feedback from you and they helped us a lot while shaping the game mechanics of Wordeous and solve the bugs. When the Wordeous was published to early access  (EA) there were only 100 words in the core pack. We increased the number to 300 during the EA. We published 3 premium word packs (Basics Pack, Games Pack, and Movies Pack) and 2 free word packs (Sports Pack and Green Pine Pack). Now, Wordeous is on full release!

[b]Update Log:[/b]

- [b]200[/b] more words added to [b]CORE PACK[/b]. Now Wordeous comes with [b]500[/b] words!

- [b]200[/b] more words added to [b]BASICS PACK[/b]. The Basics Pack DLC now has [b]700[/b] words!

- We have made some user interface improvements.

- Some game mechanics were reworked, and bugs were solved.

- There were some complains about seeing Turkish words even while English was selected. That issue was resulted by selection of Green Pine Pack while selecting the categories to play. Since Green Pine is a Turkish only DLC which was published free, we disabled the selection of Green Pine while English language was selected.

notes.content:

notes.title: Wordeous v0.2.2 is out now!
notes.content:
[b]First of all we would like to thank everyone who bought the game so far![/b] We have been watching most of the players of Wordeous who stream it on Twitch and we have noted every suggestion you have made. It's awesome to hear that you enjoy the game with your audience. To enhance the joy we would like to gift to you more words and more categories to enjoy. Here are the details;

[list]
[*] Wordeous is updated to Version 0.2.2
[*] 100 new words added to Core Words. 300 words in Basic Category is now available in Core Pack!
[*] "Sports Pack I" free DLC is now available!
[*] User interface improvements were made.
[*] Chat logging was improved,
[*] System determining the winner was improved.
[/list]

[b]Thanks for supporting us! We would be thankful if you give us suggestions on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1441430/discussions/]discussion page[/url], and write a review on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1441430/Wordeous/]Steam Store page[/url]![/b]

tags.feature: 100 new words added to Core Words.

System determining the winner was improved.

notes.title: 1st Month Update is Here!
notes.content:
[b]First of all we would like to thank everyone who bought the game so far![/b] We have encountered many bugs and crashes during the first month of the early access. We have solved every issue that are known so far. We are working real hard to make this game good, and we will continue. We would like to thank you by adding totally new 100 words in the Core Pack (200 in total), and by releasing a [b]FREE [/b]DLC. The DLC is "Green Pine Pack I" which includes words related to Turkish Cinema (movies, characters, actors and directors). [b]Thank you for supporting us![/b]

[list]
[*] Wordeous is updated to Version 0.2.1
[*] An issue causing game to crash is solved.
[*] An issue disabling the "Pass button" is solved.
[*] 100 new words added to Core Words. 200 words in Basic Category is now available in Core Pack!
[*] "Green Pine Pack I" free DLC is now available!
[/list]
